Georgia tribal organization

Lower Muskogee Creek Tribe

The Lower Muskogee Creek Tribe hosts Cultural Days and a powwow at Tama Tribal Town near Whigham. Georgia council materials list the organization, and WFSU’s October 2026 report includes an interview about the event.
